stops.title: Who can do what
stops.caption: Two system roles, many grants.
stops.speech: Kairos stores only two system roles, admin and member. Everything else is a grant: a named role pinned to a specific scope.

stops.title: Seeing it on an account
stops.caption: Open the person, read the grants.
stops.speech: Open somebody and you can see every grant they hold and where it applies, which is the honest answer to why they can see a page.
